contract: Read a DVB private stream with a DTS-HD extension descriptor and one complete access unit per aligned finite PES. Controls cover TS188, M2TS192, short and long size fields, one or two extension substreams, and both PTS-only and PTS/DTS PES.

The candidate verifies the signalled substream order, declared extents and extension header CRC, and emits each original core-bearing access unit. The source view preserves the DTS core coding-window duration and the original source clocks.

Compare the full ordered packet fold with the pinned demuxer in parser mode without stream discovery. Its DTS-HD extension descriptor packets have an unset duration, a clear key flag, and the original PES position. The comparison projects those fields; the public source packet remains unchanged.
